content.text:
The site looks right again, and both visual tests (desktop and phone) now pass. Two edits in `site/css/styles.css` were off from Bootstrap's defaults:

- **`.container` width:** it was `150%` instead of `100%`. That made the page content wider than the screen, which pushed the layout out of place on phones and shifted the text.
- **`.lead` font size:** it was `1.875rem` instead of `1.25rem`. That made the subtitle text too large.

The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't see which change introduced these. I found them by comparing against the test's diff images.

`npm start` is still running in the background from my testing. Git also shows untracked `.idea` and `.vscode` folders that I didn't create.

STATUS: DONE
